description.en: Returns the name of the track on the BGM channel (e.g. "M_08"), or an empty string if none. The ev_main helper SaveBgmHistory stores it with CMND_SND_GET_POS_BGM so OpenBgmHistory can reopen the same track later.

Name of the current BGM, "" if none.
null if the script system is not ready.

examples.case: Remembering the current music (real code, from ie4_ev_main.nut)
